name: paseo
title: Paseo
description: Ask a Paseo coding agent a question from Raycast, and browse the workspaces and tabs you already have
author: zzzeittt

commands.name: ask
commands.title: Ask Paseo
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Ask a question, watch the answer stream in, and follow up in place

arguments.name: question
arguments.placeholder: The question (Enter without one = choose host and workspace)

commands.name: quick-1
commands.title: Paseo Quick 1
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Send the prompt configured as Quick 1: fill in what changes, choose the host and workspace, and it goes

commands.name: quick-2
commands.title: Paseo Quick 2
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Send the prompt configured as Quick 2: fill in what changes, choose the host and workspace, and it goes

commands.name: quick-3
commands.title: Paseo Quick 3
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Send the prompt configured as Quick 3: fill in what changes, choose the host and workspace, and it goes

commands.name: quick-4
commands.title: Paseo Quick 4
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Send the prompt configured as Quick 4: fill in what changes, choose the host and workspace, and it goes

commands.name: workspaces
commands.title: Paseo Workspaces
commands.subtitle: Paseo
commands.description: Browse workspaces and the tabs inside them: continue, stop, archive, or open one in the desktop app

preferences.name: paseoHome
preferences.title: Paseo Home
preferences.description: Leave empty to use PASEO_HOME, or ~/.paseo

preferences.name: provider
preferences.title: Provider
preferences.description: Defaults to claude; provider/model is also accepted

preferences.name: model
preferences.title: Model
preferences.description: Leave empty to use the daemon's default model; ignored when Provider is given as provider/model

preferences.name: mode
preferences.title: Mode
preferences.description: Session mode for new agents: auto, plan, acceptEdits, default or bypassPermissions. Leave empty for the daemon's own default

preferences.name: defaultHost
preferences.title: Default Host
preferences.description: Host label or server id to start on. Leave empty for this machine

preferences.name: defaultWorkspace
preferences.title: Default Workspace
preferences.description: Ask starts in this workspace. The folder picker browses the machine Raycast runs on, so this only matches a workspace on that host — on another one, Ask falls back to the workspace last used there, and a workspace can still be named per invocation by the command's workspace argument

preferences.name: defaultCwd
preferences.title: Default Working Directory
preferences.description: The cwd for Ask when no workspace is settled, on this machine

preferences.name: paseoAppPath
preferences.title: Paseo.exe Path
preferences.description: Used by Open in Paseo Desktop; leave empty to auto-detect %LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Paseo\Paseo.exe

preferences.name: quickWorkspace
preferences.title: Quick Workspace
preferences.description: The Quick commands start in this workspace — their own setting, so a Quick send does not move Ask's Default Workspace, and the other way round. As with Ask's, the folder picker browses the machine Raycast runs on, so on another host a Quick command falls back to the workspace last used there

preferences.name: quickCwd
preferences.title: Quick Working Directory
preferences.description: The cwd for Quick commands when no workspace is settled, on this machine

preferences.name: quick1Name
preferences.title: Quick 1 Name
preferences.description: What you type after a slash. Leave the pair empty to leave the slot unused

preferences.name: quick1Prompt
preferences.title: Quick 1 Prompt
preferences.description: What Quick 1 sends. {{{…}}} is where the argument goes; its wording becomes the field's label

preferences.name: quick2Name
preferences.title: Quick 2 Name
preferences.description: What you type after a slash. Leave the pair empty to leave the slot unused

preferences.name: quick2Prompt
